name: Dash
description: A man in his mid thirties, a charming starship smuggler who sings rockabilly with a crooked grin, loose, cocky and always one step ahead.
build: A lean, rangy adult man's build of human proportions: easy shoulders, a narrow waist and long legs, standing upright with a relaxed hip.
face: Light olive skin with a faint tan, bright hazel eyes under expressive dark brows, a straight nose, a short dark stubble over a squared jaw, a small bold scar on the chin and an easy mouth.
hair: Thick dark-brown hair swept up and back into a loose rockabilly pompadour, full on top and short at the sides, one lock falling onto the forehead.
outfit: A cream cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and the collar open; a fitted dark-chocolate leather waistcoat, unbuttoned; a wide tan leather belt with a hip holster slung on the character-right thigh, the holster empty and flapped shut; slim dark-navy trousers tucked into scuffed tan knee-high flight boots.
performance_style: Cocky and loose: weight on the character-left leg, hip cocked, the character-right foot a step forward. Both arms hang easy, the character-right hand open resting on the belt buckle with fingers visible, the character-left hand open and empty at his side. Head tipped, a crooked closed-mouth grin.
location: The cargo bay of a battered freighter, seen from the front of a scuffed steel deck running to the bottom of the frame: stacked crates behind, an open ramp showing a desert moon and stars, and warm amber work lights overhead.
recognition_cues: an open dark-chocolate leather waistcoat over a cream shirt
a tan belt with an empty flapped-shut thigh holster
palette: belt, holster and flight boots tan leather #A87040 / #6E4422 / #D09A62
avoid: a gun or blaster in the holster or a hand

sing.intent: Rockabilly vocal loop: bring the mic in the character-right hand up to the mouth, snap the fingers of the open character-left hand at shoulder height on the beat, bounce a knee, then lower the mic and return to the cocky stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a loud room sound: the shoulders lift, the torso draws back slightly and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: saunter in with a loose swagger, turn square to the front, then drop into the cocky stance with the character-right hand on the belt buckle.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish: plant both boots, throw a two-finger salute off the brow with the character-left hand, the character-right hand low with the mic, a wide open-mouthed laugh, then hold the cocky hip-shot pose.
animations.ko: He stays on his feet while the stance goes slack: the shoulders drop, both open hands hang limp at the sides and the head hangs low. He holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame: no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
